components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary capsule call-to-action in Deep Ink Grey on Paper White.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #41474D; color: #F4F1EA; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #2F353A; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #41474D; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Powder Accent Button
components.description: Restrained Powder Blue accent capsule used for Visit Us and Reading Room CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-powder { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #B9D0E0; color: #41474D; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-powder:hover { background-color: #A6C2D6; } .ds-btn-powder:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-powder:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #41474D; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Category Filter Pill
components.description: Toggle pill for /menu category filtering with high-contrast Ink selected state.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #E8E8E4; background-color: #FAF8F3; color: #56616B; padding: 6px 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: #B9D0E0; color: #41474D; } .ds-pill-active { border-color: #41474D; background-color: #41474D; color: #F4F1EA; }

narrative.overview: PAHINA translates an independent neighborhood book café into a calm, sunlit digital publication. Instead of commercial storefront density or dark espresso clichés, surfaces open like warm uncoated book pages (Paper White) framed by muted architectural blue-grey accents (Powder Blue) and grounded editorial ink (Deep Ink Grey). Every screen prioritizes breathing room, legible typography, and authentic café photography over ornamental badges or stock restaurant widgets.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile uncoated paper ground paired with crisp hairline divisions rather than drop shadows.
Intentional upright-and-italic Bodoni Moda display headlines paired with restrained Instrument Serif editorial quotes and Manrope UI text.
Strict fidelity to confirmed facts and transparent, unhurried presentation of placeholder details.

rules.name: The Contrast-First Slate Rule
rules.body: Raw Slate Grey (#8999A6) is never used for readable body or caption text on Paper White; readable muted copy uses dark-shifted Slate (#56616B) so every text element exceeds WCAG 4.5:1 contrast.

rules.name: The Single-Boundary Rule
rules.body: Containers declare elevation once via a clean 1px border or surface fill—never a 1px border paired with an ambient box-shadow.

dos: Do keep Paper White (#F4F1EA) as the primary canvas and reserve Powder Blue (#B9D0E0) for focused accents, callouts, and interactive selections.
Do pair upright and italic words intentionally in Bodoni Moda display headlines (Every page holds a story.).
Do keep menu rows clean (name, sizes/prices, photo, optional Signature/Must Try pill) with tabular-nums price alignment.
donts: Don't add eyebrow kickers above section headings, middle-dot meta strings, or text arrows inside buttons.
Don't flood entire screens with blue backgrounds or introduce unrelated warm/terracotta accent colors.
Don't stretch contact-sheet thumbnail assets beyond compact editorial row sizes without replacing them at high resolution.
